items.title: Edward "Eddie" Richardson Interview, 1960-10-29
items.q: Did Rene take that trumpet solo that Percy takes? Yeah. Oh yeah. He was good at that.

ctx.x: Did you all read the hymns?

Well, we mostly played those hymns by head. Just by listening to it. Get the sound of it. I don't remember them having those hymns with music. I would get a chance to look at music, those books that they use in the choirs, in these churches, and that's how I did to catch it. And of course when I'd catch it there I'd go on with them and play it by head. What about the marches? You read them or play them by head? Well no, you had to read the marches. The march, I can remember we used to have the old march Maryland.…
Maryland we're talking about. Oh. At least I was talking about Maryland.
